title: Surface Preparation and Application of the Chromate-Free Protection System on Metallic Joints
abstract: Cleaning, deoxidising and application of the trivalent chromium conversion coating and chromate-free primer on metallic airframe joints, with the shift coupon regime that qualifies the work.

sections.purpose: This task prepares and protects a metallic faying surface with the chromate-free system, and defines the adhesion coupon that must accompany every shift of work for the protection to be accepted.
sections.job_setup_note: The station must hold the extended approval for the chromate-free process before this task is used on a structural joint. Bath chemistry, temperature and immersion times must be recorded for each batch. Once the conversion coating is applied the surface must be rinsed, dried and primed inside the stated window; if the window is exceeded the surface has to be stripped and reprocessed.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the station approval covers the chromate-free process for the joint being worked. 2. Prepare an adhesion coupon on the reference article D5120112339055 and label it with the shift and the batch. 3. Degrease the joint surfaces with the approved cleaner and confirm a continuous water break-free surface. CAUTION: A WATER BREAK ON THE SURFACE MEANS THAT CONTAMINATION REMAINS. REPEAT THE DEGREASE. 4. Deoxidise the surfaces for the time given in the process sheet and rinse thoroughly. 5. Apply the trivalent chromium conversion coating for the stated immersion time. WARNING: THE DEOXIDISER IS ACIDIC AND CAUSES BURNS. WEAR THE FULL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AND KEEP THE EYE WASH STATION READY. 6. Rinse and dry the surfaces and start the priming inside the stated window. 7. Apply the chromate-free epoxy primer to the film thickness given on drawing D51201131570 and measure it at three points. 8. Cure the primer to the schedule and record the oven or ambient conditions. 9. Process the shift coupon with the work and test it for adhesion after the humidity soak. 10. Where the coupon fails, quarantine every joint processed in that shift. 11. Replace any grommet AES445369-54 disturbed during the work, because its compound is not compatible with the new primer cure.
sections.close_out: Record the bath chemistry, the immersion times, the film thickness readings and the coupon result against the work order. Return the reference article and the coupon carrier bracket D5120116861898 to the controlled store. Dispose of the process chemicals through the approved route. Make the entry in the aircraft technical record against the joint that was protected.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft, for any joint opened during repair or modification

safety_precautions: Wear full protective equipment when you handle the deoxidiser.
Keep the eye wash station ready and tested.
Make sure that the area has forced ventilation.
Do not let the process chemicals reach the aircraft drain path.

abstract: Cleaning, deoxidising and application of the trivalent chromium conversion coating and chromate-free primer on metallic airframe joints, with the mixed solution shelf life and the shift coupon regime that qualify the work.

sections.purpose: This task prepares and protects a metallic faying surface with the chromate-free system, and defines the adhesion coupon that must accompany every shift of work for the protection to be accepted.
sections.job_setup_note: The station must hold the extended approval for the chromate-free process before this task is used on a structural joint. Bath chemistry, temperature and immersion times must be recorded for each batch. Once the conversion coating is applied the surface must be rinsed, dried and primed inside the stated window; if the window is exceeded the surface has to be stripped and reprocessed. The conversion solution has a working life of eight hours from the moment it is mixed, and no more than four hours once it has been used on a first batch. Mark the mixing time on the bath at the moment of mixing. Discard the solution at the end of its working life whatever it looks like: it stays clear and gives no visual warning as it ages, and over-age solution is the single commonest cause of a failed shift coupon. Do not top up an ageing bath with fresh concentrate to extend it.
